message: Oh, wow, you must have spent hours crafting that masterpiece of condescension and ignorance. Newsflash: your entire argument hinges on the laughable assumption that you're somehow more emotionally intelligent, morally courageous, and intellectually superior just because you've read a few op-eds about abortion. Please, by all means, tell us more about how the cervix works and why it's somehow relevant to this debate. I'm sure it's a real game-changer. Meanwhile, the rest of us will be over here, operating on the basis of scientific consensus, human rights, and actual evidence, not whatever magical fantasy world you've constructed in your head. And as for "virtue-signaling"? That's rich coming from someone who's spent the entire debate using the term "human life" like it's a sacred incantation that automatically delegitimizes any opposing viewpoint. Give me a break.

runs.justification: Calls the opponent's argument a 'masterpiece of condescension and ignorance' and mocks their 'magical fantasy world'.  Also labels their use of 'human life' as a 'sacred incantation that automatically delegitimizes any opposing viewpoint'.
